name: After Login Redirect (alr)
description: Configures where users are redirected after login and after logout.
project_description:
After Login/Logout Redirection module allows you to control the destination that a user is redirected to after logging in or logout from the system.

 Login and Logout Redirection: The module enables users to specify the destination they are redirected to after logging in or logging out of the system.

 Features 
 User Control: Users have control over where they are redirected upon login or logout, enhancing the user experience.

 Post-Installation Configuration: The module offers a configuration form that simplifies the process of managing redirection settings for both login and logout actions.

 Versatile Destination Options: Users can set the redirection destination to any internal page within the system. They have the flexibility to use a full URL or a URL that starts with the '/' character.

 Compatibility: The module is compatible with Drupal versions 8, 9, and 10, ensuring its usability across different Drupal platforms.

 Comprehensive Functionality: It provides all the necessary features for efficient login and logout redirection, enhancing the overall usability of the system.

 Reliable Performance: Users can expect the module to work reliably and perform well, contributing to a smooth login and logout experience.
